content.short: US digital bank with checking, savings and cards.
content.description: Varo Bank is a US digital bank notable for being one of the first fintechs to obtain a full national bank charter, letting it offer banking directly rather than through a partner institution. Through its app, Varo provides fee-free checking and high-yield savings accounts, a debit card, early direct deposit, short-term cash advances, secured credit-building products, and cashback rewards. It targets everyday Americans, especially those underserved by traditional banks or hurt by fees and overdraft charges, emphasizing no monthly fees and inclusive access. By holding its own bank charter and building around low-cost, mobile-first accounts and credit-building tools, Varo aims to deliver a more affordable and accessible banking experience, competing with other US consumer neobanks for mainstream and financially underserved customers.
